name: OpenAlex
summary: Open catalog of scholarly works, authors, institutions, sources and topics, with citations, open-access status and grouping counts.

api_key.description: Optional free OpenAlex API key (openalex.org account); raises the daily budget 10x and the rate limit from 10 to 30 requests per second. Sent as the api_key query parameter.

notes: Works without a key on a small daily budget; a free key gives $1 of usage a day, resetting at midnight UTC, and is needed to follow cursor paging past the first page.
Rate limit: 10 requests/second keyless, 30 with a free key; semantic search 1 per second.
page/per_page paging stops at 10,000 results (page * per_page); use cursor=* for more. per_page max is 100.
group_by returns up to 200 groups per page and pages only by cursor.

endpoints.name: Search and filter scholarly works
endpoints.summary: Papers, books and datasets matching a search and/or filters, or counts grouped by a field.

search.description: Full-text search over the entity's searchable fields. AND, OR, NOT in uppercase; quotes for phrases.

filter.description: Comma-separated field:value filters (comma = AND, | = OR, ! = NOT, > and < for ranges), e.g. publication_year:2024,is_oa:true.

sort.description: field or field:desc; display_name, cited_by_count, works_count, publication_date (works), relevance_score (needs search). Comma-separate several.

select.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return, e.g. id,display_name.

group_by.description: Up to three comma-separated fields to count by instead of listing records; :include_unknown after a field keeps unknowns.

page.description: Page number; page * per_page may not exceed 10,000.

cursor.description: Cursor paging: start with * and pass meta.next_cursor; reaches past 10,000 results. Needs a free key past the first page.

search_semantic.description: Semantic (embedding) search by meaning, e.g. an abstract. Cannot be combined with another search parameter; limited to 1 request per second.

notes: Pricing (help.openalex.org search page): list+filter calls cost $0.10 per 1,000, search calls $1 per 1,000. Each response reports its own cost in meta.cost_usd.
Fetching up to 100 records by ID in one list request (an OR filter on the ID) costs one list call, cheaper than 100 single lookups.

endpoints.name: Get a work
endpoints.summary: One work record by OpenAlex ID or external ID.

id.description: OpenAlex ID (W2741809807), doi:10.7717/peerj.4375, pmid:29456894, or the full https://doi.org/... URL.
